instructions.theAimContent: Train and move your Patapon tribe through each level. Destroy obstacles, accumulate tribesmen and unlock rewards for yourself along the way. Hurry up, a Patapon festival celebration awaits!
instructions.whatToDoContent1: Build up your tribe's confidence and practice your marching skills before heading off to Time Attack mode. Just hit the correct sequence of keys to match the scrolling drum icons at the top of the screen. Be sure to keep the beat!
instructions.whatToDoContent2: After you have honed your skills in Practice Mode, give this competitive mode a go to unlock some treats. More challenging skills (Marching, Attacking, Trumpeting) will truly test the might of your tribe.
instructions.keysContent: Match the keys with the symbols shown in the scrolling drum icons at the top of the screen.

downloads.nothingUnlocked: Train and move your Patapon tribe through each level. Destroy obstacles, accumulate tribesmen and unlock rewards for yourself along the way. Hurry up, a Patapon festival celebration awaits!
downloads.downloadsUnlocked: Your tribe must like you. They have granted you access to some of their treasure.

level.part1: Your Patapon tribesmen react differently to various drum combinations. Pata Pata Pata Pon will cause your Patapons to march to the beat.
level.part2: The Chaka Chaka Pata Pon combination will draw their shields and protect them from dangerous whirlwinds.
level.part3: Get your tribe through hostile territory!

level.part1: A dilapidated castle needs to be destroyed. March and gallop your tribe to the demolition site with the drum sequence Pata Pata Pata Pon.
level.part2: Bring it all down by attacking the castle with the combination Pon Pon Pata Pon.

level.part1: Your tribe needs a little more practice with their musical instruments before they can join in with all the merriment at the Patapon festival celebration.
level.part2: Listen closely and repeat the notes of the band leader.

gameOver.loserText: You need to move quicker than that if you want to make it to the festival on time!

gameComplete.wellDone: Congratulations! You made it! The Patapons agree: you will make a fine tribal leader.
